methods.name: send_event
methods.summary: Something changed in a trip. One event per change, in change-number order for each trip.

methods.name: card_tap
methods.summary: Someone tapped a button on one of Go's cards. Go answers what the App should do.

methods.name: catch_up
methods.summary: Someone came back to the room after a while. Go answers what they missed.

methods.name: get_person
methods.summary: What Go knows about a person, with where each fact came from.

methods.name: update_person
methods.summary: Turn carry-over on or off for a person.

methods.name: delete_fact
methods.summary: Remove one thing Go knows about a person.

methods.name: forget_person
methods.summary: Forget me: in one trip, or everywhere.

methods.name: vault_link
methods.summary: A short-lived link to the person's vault page, to open in the browser sheet.

methods.name: read_trip
methods.summary: Read the whole trip as Go may see it, at its current change number.

methods.name: read_messages
methods.summary: Read messages posted or changed after a change number. Used to catch up after a gap or a restart.

methods.name: post_message
methods.summary: Go says something in the room: text, a card, or both.

methods.name: replace_card
methods.summary: Replace a card Go posted earlier, in place. Not a change to the trip: no event.

methods.name: typing
methods.summary: Show or hide "Go is typing..." in the room.

methods.name: add_reaction
methods.summary: Go reacts to a message.

methods.name: remove_reaction
methods.summary: Go takes its reaction back.

methods.name: update_trip
methods.summary: Change the title, destination, dates, vibe, stay or the itinerary.

methods.name: open_vote
methods.summary: Open a vote.

methods.name: close_vote
methods.summary: Close a vote now and get the result.

methods.name: set_mandate
methods.summary: Set what the group allowed for a closed choice vote: the choice, the cap, refundable only, and who pays.

methods.name: add_record_line
methods.summary: Add an agreed, open or doing line to the trip record.

methods.name: update_record_line
methods.summary: Change a line Go wrote, or mark it done.

methods.name: add_booking
methods.summary: Record a confirmed booking.

methods.name: update_booking
methods.summary: Change or cancel a booking.

methods.name: add_expense
methods.summary: Record something someone paid for, split between people.

methods.name: request_spend_approval
methods.summary: Run the spend check. Answers with a signed, one-use spend approval for the vault, or the reason why not.

methods.name: cancel_spend_approval
methods.summary: Release an approval Go will not use. Not a change to the trip: no event.
